review_candidates.description: Description This is a full-time remote or hybrid position based in the Fort Lauderdale, FL area. Reporting directly to the CFO, the core of this role is FP&A, and that is where the work starts. You will own the enterprise planning, forecasting, and management reporting engine: the annual budget, the quarterly forecast, the multi-year outlook, and the reporting package the executive team and our investors run on. Strong FP&A fundamentals are the requirement, not the aspiration, and the first priority is doing that work exceptionally well. We are also hiring with the next several years in view. This is a finance organization in build mode, and for the right person the scope of this seat is expected to widen over time; toward deeper partnership with our commercial and operating leaders, toward the connection between operating KPIs, business intelligence, and financial outcomes, and toward broader enterprise finance leadership. We are looking for someone who can deliver on the FP&A mandate immediately and has the range to grow well past it. About Us MASA has been a leader in emergency medical transportation insurance since 1974. We're not just a company – we're a close-knit team dedicated to "Protecting families with compassion when others don't." Our professional yet friendly company culture fosters collaboration, innovation, and a clear mission that resonates through every role as we support our expanding base of 2+ million members across the United States and the Caribbean. Learn more at https://www.masaaccess.com What You Will Do Enterprise Planning, Forecasting, and Reporting Lead the enterprise annual budget and quarterly forecast processes end to end. Formalize and publish the planning calendar and hold the organization to submission deadlines and quality standards. Standardize submission templates and assumptions to drive consistency across segments and functions. Build and maintain the multi-year enterprise financial outlook, including scenario and sensitivity analysis to support strategic and capital decisions. Own the monthly financial reporting process and the standard artifact set delivered to executive leadership and external stakeholders. Own the rolling cash flow forecast and working capital analysis in partnership with Treasury and Accounting. Business Partnership and Decision Support Serve as the FP&A partner to segment, commercial, and functional leaders; present for their planning and performance discussions, and be trusted to help them make better decisions with better information. Partner with segment leaders to assess financial trends, size EBITDA improvement opportunities, and support execution of performance initiatives. Bring financial rigor to growth investments, pricing, and other significant business decisions through clear business cases, and close the loop on whether the results materialized. Lead the Corporate operating expense controller process, including recurring actual versus budget reviews with functional leaders. Drive identification and execution of cost savings, with particular focus on IT operating and capital spend. Partner with Human Resources on hiring plan oversight, approvals, and business cases for exceptions. Establish the capital expenditure and investment review process, including business case standards, ROI analysis, and post-implementation review of major spend. Reporting, KPIs, and Analytics Help make the linkage between operating KPIs and financial results explicit: how volume, mix, retention, utilization, and productivity translate into revenue, margin, and cash. Partner with Business Intelligence to automate KPI production and management reporting, reducing manual FP&A workload and shortening the distance between a question and a credible answer. Pressure-test what the data is saying. Ask why a trend moved, chase the operational root cause, and surface the insight before it is requested. Building for Scale Design and stand up processes that do not exist today, with the documentation, cadence, and controls that make them durable as the company grows. Put AI to work inside the finance function, using it to accelerate analysis, variance commentary, documentation, and recurring deliverables, and set the standards for how the team uses it responsibly with financial data. Identify and lead process changes that improve stability and efficiency as the company scales. Provide ad hoc analysis and decision support to the CFO and executive team. Support external reporting, audit, and diligence requests with well-documented analysis. What You Bring Core Requirements Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. MBA or CPA preferred. 10+ years of progressive FP&A experience, including time spent as a dedicated finance partner to commercial, revenue, or operating leaders. Demonstrated ownership of a full annual budget and forecast cycle in a multi-segment or multi-entity environment. Track record of building finance processes where none existed, not only running processes someone else designed. Advanced Excel and hands-on experience with an ERP and a financial planning system. Working knowledge of business intelligence and visualization tools. Practical, hands-on use of AI tools in a finance context, with sound judgment about where the output must be verified before it reaches a decision-maker. Experience in a private equity-backed environment, including diligence and quality of earnings support. Insurance, membership, subscription, or healthcare services experience preferred. What Will Set You Apart You think about the whole business, not just your slice of it. You can hold the enterprise P&L, the operating model, and the customer in view at the same time. You are commercially and business-inclined; drawn to the decisions behind the numbers, and comfortable having a point of view in front of the people making them. You are an exceptional stakeholder partner. Operating leaders come to you early because your input makes their decisions better. You are genuinely curious. You dig past the variance to the driver, and you keep asking until the story holds together. You present with clarity and credibility to executive audiences, and you can translate complexity without diluting it. You are comfortable with ambiguity and with building from the ground up, and you move between the strategic and the hands-on without friction. You are fluent in how operational KPIs drive financial outcomes, and comfortable working alongside business intelligence or data teams to get reporting productionized. You are an early and deliberate adopter of AI in your own workflow. You experiment, you know where it earns its keep and where it does not, and you bring the people around you along with you. You are looking for a role you can grow into rather than a role you have already outgrown, and you bring the ambition, judgment, and pace to take on more as the company scales. What Success Looks Like In Year One A planning calendar and forecast process the organization runs on, with clean templates, maintained deadlines, and forecasts leadership trusts. Operating leaders describe you as their finance partner rather than their reporting contact. Early, visible progress connecting operational KPIs to financial results, with the recurring reporting behind them increasingly automated in partnership with Business Intelligence. At least one material process built from scratch and operating without you having to hold it up. A defined set of FP&A workflows measurably faster or better because of AI, with clear ground rules for how it is used on financial data. How The Role Can Grow The immediate mandate is FP&A, and we expect the first year to be spent making that function excellent. From there, and at a pace set by the person in the seat, we expect the scope to extend: into closer partnership with the leaders who run our commercial and operating areas, and into the intersection of business intelligence, operating KPIs, and financial performance. You will work closely with the CFO and the executive team. Our lab and engineering efforts are directed toward pioneer-level architectures bridging current paradigm gaps to move closer to Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) and Artificial Superintelligence (ASI). We are seeking a world-class Technical Co-Founder & Chief Technology Officer (CTO). a rare hybrid of an enterprise AI/ML Architect, a Deep Tech Researcher, and an uncompromising Startup Builder. Note on Role Structure: This is a 100% equity-based Co-Founder position prior to institutional funding. We are looking for a true partner who possesses relentless founder grit, high perseverance, and an authentic passion for foundational AI innovation. Technical Scope & Architectural Domain As CTO, you will own the technical blueprint, algorithmic core, and system architecture end-to-end. You will work on hybrid AI models combining neuro-symbolic reasoning, knowledge representations, and scalable statistical deep learning. 1. AI Architecture & AGI/ASI Research Pathways Hybrid & Neuro-Symbolic AI : Lead the design and implementation of production-grade Symbolic Engines, integrated with Probabilistic Logic Networks (PLN) and formal reasoning frameworks. Graph & Knowledge Systems: Design, construct, and query massive Knowledge Bases and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to enable deterministic, explainable, and relational AI reasoning. Deep Learning & Neural Architectures: Architect custom Neural Network topologies (Transformers, Diffusion, Graph-based, and Recurrent models) optimized for multi-modal reasoning and dynamic learning. 2. Algorithmic Engineering & Core Pipelines Algorithm Development: Research, benchmark, and deploy novel algorithmic solutions for complex reasoning, data ingestion, and multi-agent coordination. Production Pipelines: Build scalable, end-to-end AI/ML production pipelines—spanning dataset curation, data synthesis, model training, evaluation, automated CI/CD, and low-latency inference. System Efficiency & Compute: Optimize training and inference workloads across distributed GPU/TPU clusters, ensuring high throughput, memory efficiency, and fault tolerance. 3. Key Responsibilities & Founder Ownership Product & Platform Architecture: Personally architect and engineer the foundational MVP, establishing standard-setting enterprise code quality, performance metrics, and security protocols. R&D Leadership: Translate cutting-edge AI lab research (neuro-symbolic integration, PLN, GNNs) into functional, commercial-grade product features. Strategic Roadmap & Vision: Co-define the company's long-term product-market strategy alongside non-technical co-founders. Team Construction: Post-funding, recruit, mentor, and lead an elite team of AI researchers, ML engineers, and system architects. 4. Target Profile & Requirements Deep Technical Mastery: Hands-on experience developing complex algorithms, Symbolic engines, GNNs, PLN, and production-ready Machine Learning / Deep Learning pipelines. Research & Systems Mindset: Solid understanding of modern AI paradigms and a driving ambition toward AGI/ASI capabilities through novel architectural approaches. Founder Qualities & Grit: Unwavering perseverance, comfort navigating zero-to-one ambiguity, and an ownership mindset capable of building ground-up without immediate corporate infrastructure. Track Record: Previous experience as a Principal AI Architect, Lead AI Researcher, VP of AI Engineering, or Technical Startup Founder . 5. Equity & Compensation Structure Co-Founder Equity : Significant equity share reflecting true co-founder partnership status (subject to standard founder vesting terms). Future Cash Compensation: Executive-level benchmarked salary and performance incentives immediately upon securing venture/institutional funding. 6. How to Apply / Connect If you are driven by a passion for fundamental AI innovation and want to build a defining deep-tech company from the ground up, let's talk. Direct Message: Send a direct message on LinkedIn highlighting your experience with Symbolic AI, GNNs, or AI pipelines. Email: Reach out directly with your resume, research papers, or GitHub/portfolio at Ash.m@siellium.com #AI #MachineLearning #DeepLearning #SymbolicAI #AGI #ASI #GraphNeuralNetworks #PLN #ArtificialIntelligence #CTO #CoFounder #DeepTech #Startups #SoftwareArchitecture

review_candidates.title: Chief Executive Officer
review_candidates.description: About Cenevia Cenevia is a trusted healthcare services organization providing revenue cycle management, credentialing, provider enrollment, consulting, and operational support solutions for Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), community health centers, and healthcare organizations nationwide. Our mission is to help healthcare organizations strengthen financial performance, improve operational efficiency, navigate complex regulatory environments, and expand access to care for the communities they serve. Cenevia is seeking an experienced and strategic Chief Executive Officer to build upon this strong foundation and guide the organization through its next phase of operational advancement, service excellence, and sustainable growth. The Opportunity The CEO serves as the organization's chief executive and works in partnership with the Board of Directors to implement the strategic direction established by the Board. The CEO is responsible for organizational leadership, financial performance, operational execution, client satisfaction, workforce development, and the overall success of the organization. The ideal candidate will be a collaborative healthcare leader with a strong track record of operational excellence, relationship building, organizational leadership, and healthcare services management. This individual will balance innovation with practicality while continuing to strengthen the culture, reputation, and long-term sustainability of the organization. Location: Remote. CEO must be available for periodic in person meetings at the Henrico, Virginia headquarters and other travel as needed. Reports To: Board of Directors Key Responsibilities Strategic Execution & Organizational Leadership Partner with the Board of Directors to implement the organization's strategic vision and priorities. Translate Board-approved objectives into actionable operational plans and measurable outcomes. Provide recommendations and industry insights to support Board decision-making and long-term planning. Align organizational resources, leadership efforts, and investments with strategic priorities established by the Board. Monitor healthcare industry trends and advise the Board regarding opportunities, risks, and operational considerations. Operational & Financial Leadership Provide executive oversight of organizational operations, service delivery, and performance. Ensure financial sustainability, profitability, and operational effectiveness. Establish and monitor key performance indicators and accountability measures. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance client outcomes and organizational efficiency. Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, contractual, and organizational requirements. Client & Business Development Strengthen relationships with existing clients and healthcare partners. Support business development and client retention efforts. Represent the organization within the healthcare community and industry associations. Maintain a strong understanding of FQHC operations, reimbursement, regulatory, and revenue cycle challenges. Identify opportunities to expand services and deepen client partnerships consistent with Board-approved priorities. Technology & Organizational Advancement Support the thoughtful adoption of technology, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled tools that improve service delivery and business performance. Champion initiatives that increase operational effectiveness, scalability, and reporting capabilities. Ensure technology investments align with organizational goals, client needs, and financial objectives. Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation where it creates meaningful value for clients and employees. People & Culture Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing leadership team. Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, transparency, and service excellence. Support succession planning and leadership development throughout the organization. Attract, retain, and develop exceptional talent. Ensure employees remain engaged, informed, and aligned with organizational objectives. Governance & Stakeholder Relations Serve as the primary liaison between management and the Board of Directors. Provide regular updates regarding organizational performance, strategic initiatives, and key risks. Maintain productive relationships with clients, shareholders, partners, vendors, and industry stakeholders. Support strong governance, compliance, and risk management practices. Qualifications Required Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field. Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible senior leadership experience, including executive-level responsibility for operations, finance, strategy, or organizational leadership. Demonstrated success leading healthcare organizations, healthcare services companies, or related businesses. Strong financial, operational, and strategic execution experience. Proven ability to build relationships, develop teams, and achieve organizational objectives. Exceptional communication, leadership, and decision-making skills. Preferred Experience serving or partnering with Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), community health centers, or other safety-net healthcare organizations. Experience in healthcare operations, revenue cycle management, healthcare consulting, healthcare technology, or business services. MBA, MHA, or other advanced degree or Masters Prepared Experience leading organizational transformation, operational improvement, or technology modernization initiatives. Leadership Attributes The successful candidate will be: Strategic and results-oriented Collaborative and relationship-focused Operationally disciplined Financially astute Client-centered Adaptable and forward-thinking Committed to developing people and culture Skilled at leading through change Authentic, transparent, and accountable Why Join Cenevia? This is an exceptional opportunity to lead a respected healthcare services organization with a strong reputation, talented employees, and deep expertise supporting FQHCs and healthcare providers. The next CEO will build upon a solid foundation while helping shape the organization's future through operational excellence, thoughtful innovation, outstanding client service, and sustainable growth. Cenevia is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourages applications from qualified candidates who are passionate about supporting healthcare organizations and improving operational and financial outcomes across the communities they serve.

Administrar y resguardar herramientas, equipos y repuestos asignados para las intervenciones en terreno. Disponibilidad para trabajo en terreno y traslados. Responsabilidad, autonomía, orientación al cliente y capacidad de resolución de problemas.
